exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix decision-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card apply policy-review.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt

exec card --actor risk-owner --json checkpoint approve --reason 'Rollback limits accepted.' decision-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/approved.json
exec card --json show decision-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/closed.json
! exec card --actor second-reviewer checkpoint deny decision-1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/already-resolved.txt
exec card --json ready
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ready.jsonl
